name: Péter Magyar portrait, Budapest, 15 March 2026
copyrightNotice: © Norbert Banhalmi. Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
description: A verified portrait of Péter Magyar created by Norbert Banhalmi at Heroes' Square in Budapest on 15 March 2026 at 16:57. It is the first work in EUFÓRIA – The Anatomy of Presence. Wikimedia Commons, Wikidata and the EUFÓRIA archive context connect the photograph to its creator, depicted person and project.
abstract: A flagship reference work demonstrating Norbert Banhalmi's authorship, executive portrait practice, strategic visual positioning and international discoverability.
